verdict.rationale: Ramp documents ACH/wire capabilities (same-day ACH, RTP instant payments, vendor payments '2 days faster') but there is no evidence of a UI or API feature that shows a finance-lead an exact delivery estimate for a specific ACH/wire transfer before they confirm it. missing for 10: any documentation of a pre-confirmation delivery-date/time estimate shown to the user, UI screenshots or API fields for estimated arrival, and confirmation this is surfaced per-transaction rather than as general marketing speed claims.
